title: G6 app \ xDrip app difference - need help
symptom: User reports frequent Bluetooth connection losses with xDrip app (every 120-140 minutes at night, and daytime delays of 8-9 minutes vs receiver's 5 minutes), while the G6 app works without issues. The problem persists even when the phone is 15 cm away.
evidence_quote: Is there any reason why g6 app and xdrip app are so different? They both use bluetooth, and i really prefer xdrip, but the connection are very annoying...
